profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer, primarily in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node & React
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience. I code primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and React.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build and maintain Node.js services supporting enterprise internal applications and tools
- Design and ship APls integrating modern services with legacy systems, improving internal operations
- Improve deployment reliability and observability using Azure DevOps
- Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers and product managers to deliver production features in an agile environment
- Thoughtful use of AI-assisted tools including GitHub Copilot to improve development efficiency and code quality
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Node.js · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL · MongoDB · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed internal tooling and shared component libraries used across multiple products as part of an infrastructure team
- Transitioned to a measurement feature team following reorganization and shipped advertising management features
- Built campaign and account management workflows integrating GraphQL and backend services for advertising operations
- Built product features and tools using PostgreSQL systems, supporting data modeling, querying, and backend integrations
- Enhanced internal component libraries to improve Ul consistency and accelerate feature delivery across teams
positions.insights: Skills: ReactJS · npm · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · GraphQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Primary front-end engineer for a cloud infrastructure management platform
- Led front-end architecture and development of React & TypeScript applications using Apollo GraphQL
- Contributed to Node.js backend services and GraphQL schema design & service integration
- Worked with Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, and infrastructure services
- Assisted development workflows involving AWS and GCP environments
- Supported Docker build & deployment workflows to improve consistency between development environments
- Implemented scalable Ul systems using Material Ul and styled-components
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · ReactJS · Node.js · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack Software Engineer on a small team, building a vehicle marketplace web application from the ground up. Focused primarily on front-end with a React w/ Redux architecture, with a Node server for back-end and Firebase for data handling & storage, deployed through AWS. Implemented multiple APIs, including Stripe for payments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, primarily focused on front-end. 
On a relatively small team developing web app for CourseKey's education platform. 
Web-app built in React/Redux architecture, Node/Express on the back-end. Implemented multiple APIs, deployed through AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · ReactJS · Redux · Node.js · sass

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
Incorporated Meetup API to automatically request, update, format, and cache events on the public  events page. Cached with HapiJS server and displayed using Slm, with Sass and Bootstrap

Assisted teaching students JavaScript, data structures, algorithms, ReactJS, and authentication

Worked help­desk, held one­on­one sessions, ran whiteboarding session, mentored students, and  performed talks on the Internet of Things and computer emulation

positions.title: Business Operations Specialist III
positions.description:
Manage and coordinate damage claims, including keeping track of them over time and ensuring accountability.

Analyze situations and offer resolution based on facts after investigation.

Route technician work orders across various US cities and regions.

Analyze logistical information to increase productivity and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, time-critical work environment;

projects.title: Neighborhood Numbers
projects.description:
-Web app for displaying crime statistics within a region of Los Angeles based on user's address input.
-Crime data was scraped from various sources, stored in a PostgreSQL database and displayed via Google Maps API with AngularJS front-end.

projects.title: freeday
projects.description:
-Event discovery application that parses request data from the Meetup API and displays it via Google Maps API based on latitude and longitude coordinates.
-Automatically centers around the users geolocation displays upcoming events within a certain radius.
-Plan to add Eventbrite and user-created events.
